integrity: Exact rising-factorial moments, symbolic quartic derivative, discriminant factorization with positive certificate, projective-boundary check, and independent density quadrature reproduced by included code.
scientific_limitations: Real centered quadratic-or-lower Gamma polynomials for each shape >0, fourth moments. Excludes higher degrees and multivariate mixtures; endpoint formulas are unique signed quartic roots. Unindexed equivalences remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp fourth-moment geometry of centered quadratic gamma polynomials
